comment: AGENTS.md 16.6: a median regression above default_pct after repeated runs is an alert; a single noisy run is never a hard failure. Correctness, crash and security failures are hard failures elsewhere (CTest). Keys are metric-name prefixes of docs/test-evidence/benchmarks/summary.json; the longest matching prefix wins.
notes: Image wall times are single or few samples on this machine and dominated by model load from a USB drive; treat their alerts as provisional (ADR-010). Compare only runs with the same model hash, backend, build and driver.
